metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Mara Satzbau
records.biography_en: In The Language Wing, Mara Satzbau takes the role of German teacher. “The verb has escaped again.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: three chunky sentence tiles fitted like a tiny bridge.

records.name: Ned Homophone
records.biography_en: In The Language Wing, Ned Homophone takes the role of English teacher. “Those sound suspiciously alike.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two small clay speech tokens with pictograms of a bee and a capital B.

records.name: Iris Accentgrave
records.biography_en: In The Language Wing, Iris Accentgrave takes the role of French teacher. “The accent has a direction.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small slate with a single sculpted è and a chalk nub.

records.name: Bram Tilde
records.biography_en: In The Language Wing, Bram Tilde takes the role of Spanish teacher. “There. It has its hat.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small tilde-shaped clay piece held just above a miniature lowercase n block.

records.name: Ollie Declension
records.biography_en: In The Language Wing, Ollie Declension takes the role of Latin teacher. “That ending has been here before.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: miniature wax tablet with a short rounded stylus.

records.name: Gus Wordbridge
records.biography_en: In The Language Wing, Gus Wordbridge takes the role of German as a second language teacher. “Start with the word you have.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: little key and two large picture cards with a door and an apple.
